title: Create cards inside a group
text: Double-click empty space inside a group’s shaded boundary to add a card to that group. The card opens for editing at the spot you clicked. Double-click outside the shading to create an ungrouped card.
chapters: Before, the card cuts a gap in the group
Double-click inside Checkout to add a card
Create an ungrouped card on the open canvas

more.title: The second tap picks the group
more.text: When a double-tap crosses a group’s shaded boundary, the new card follows the second tap. That point determines both where the card lands and which group it joins.
chapters: Before, the first tap picked the group
The card now follows the second tap
